name: Plan 1:1
summary:
Plan 1:1 lays your 2D floor plan on the real floor around you at true 1:1 scale. Put on your Meta Quest, walk from room to room and feel how big the space really is, before anything is built.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Upload the PDF of your plan at plan1to1.com.
2. Get a 3-letter code or a QR code.
3. Enter it in the headset, place the plan on the floor and walk.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- See your plan on the floor in mixed reality, at the scale read from the drawing. You can always check and correct the scale yourself.
